title: Encoded PowerShell command executed on WORKSTATION6 as SYSTEM
summary: At 16:16:57 on 2020-09-20, PowerShell ran with a base64-encoded command (-enc flag) as SYSTEM on WORKSTATION6, launched by cmd.exe (parent: services.exe). The decoded command attempts to disable ScriptBlockLogging and AMSI (T1562.001), then contacts external IP 10.10.10.5 (suspicious, not in company ranges) to download and execute additional code (T1027, T1059.001). The whoami.exe execution immediately after confirms reconnaissance. This is a clear attack chain with defense evasion and external communication.
evidence: PowerShell -enc flag observed in process creation logs
Decoded command disables ScriptBlockLogging and EnableScriptBlockInvocationLogging
Command contacts IP 10.10.10.5 (suspicious private address, not in company network)
whoami.exe executed as child of the encoded PowerShell session
Process chain: services.exe -> cmd.exe -> powershell.exe (with -enc) -> conhost.exe -> whoami.exe

recommended_actions.action: Capture full PowerShell transcript and memory dump from WORKSTATION6
Block outbound connections to IP 10.10.10.5 at perimeter firewall
Review all other hosts for similar encoded PowerShell executions with -enc flag
Check for newly created scheduled tasks or services on WORKSTATION6

title: Malicious service 'Updater' executes encoded PowerShell on WORKSTATION6
summary: At 16:16:58 on 2020-09-20, user pgustavo logged into WORKSTATION6 from 172.18.39.5 and immediately installed a malicious service named 'Updater'. This service launched cmd.exe and PowerShell with an encoded command that disables script block logging, bypasses AMSI, and downloads payloads from 10.10.10.5. The user pgustavo is normally based on WORKSTATION5, making this access anomalous. The activity matches a coordinated attack chain involving remote services, service creation, and PowerShell execution with defense evasion.
evidence: pgustavo logged into WORKSTATION6 from 172.18.39.5 at 16:16:58.212 (auth success)
Service 'Updater' installed by pgustavo launched cmd.exe then powershell -noP -sta -w 1 -enc (encoded command)
Decoded PowerShell disables ScriptBlockLogging, bypasses AMSI, downloads from http://10.10.10.5
Network connection from powershell.exe (SYSTEM) to 10.10.10.5:80 at 16:17:04
pgustavo is a Domain user (lab) with normal host WORKSTATION5, not WORKSTATION6
ALERT-001 also involved encoded PowerShell on WORKSTATION6, indicating attack chain continuation
IP 172.18.39.5 rated internal but user behavior is anomalous for this host

title: C2 Beacon via Encoded PowerShell on WORKSTATION6

The decoded command disables security controls (ScriptBlockLogging, AMSI), downloads and runs code from the web, and uses nested base64 obfuscation. This is part of a coordinated attack chain with ALERT-001 and ALERT-002 on the same host.
